description: A direct request to tell a creditor of the death and ask what is owing: a creditor notification

matter.title: Estate of Gwendolyn May Pryce
openTasks: List the house for sale after Easter

query: We found an unpaid Geelong Energy bill in Gwendolyn's name. Can you write to them about her death and ask what's owing?
answer: I can't write or send letters from the chat, but Materia can offer to start one for you to check. Geelong Energy isn't on the matter yet, so the letter will need their address.
